visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit modern kitchen featuring white countertops and light wood-textured cabinets. A woman's hand, with light-colored manicured nails, enters the frame to present a series of kitchen organization tools, starting with a clear plastic condiment box with a white lid. (2) Close-up shots follow, showing the hand interacting with the condiment box, specifically demonstrating a small white measuring spoon and a moisture-proof seal inside the lid. The background remains the clean, organized kitchen environment with soft overhead lighting. (3) The perspective shifts to show a clear glass oil bottle with a beige lid being held and tilted, showcasing its automatic opening mechanism. (4) The video transitions to several wall-mounted magnetic organization solutions; a hand is seen attaching white magnetic brackets to the kitchen wall, followed by holding a specialized magnetic rack designed for pot lids. (5) A new segment shows the woman pulling out a large kitchen drawer, revealing an array of white ceramic plates neatly organized in a white vertical rack system. She picks up one plate to demonstrate the ease of access. (6) The camera moves to high-level storage, where the hand pulls down a semi-transparent plastic bin with a sturdy handle from a wooden upper cabinet, displaying its contents clearly. (7) Another drawer is opened to show various stainless steel pots and pans arranged in an adjustable wire organizer. The hand adjusts one of the metal dividers to fit a specific pot. (8) A white three-tier utility cart is introduced, equipped with a side pegboard holding various accessories like hooks and baskets for drying cups. (9) Finally, the woman appears on screen in a full shot, wearing a white t-shirt and grey trousers, smiling and waving to the camera in her kitchen.

(19) [Logo]: IKEA 小推車. (20) [Subtitle]: 再來是我家的小推車 推車跟洞洞板配件都是ikea的 固定的是大創買的 洞洞板設計可以吊掛常用的廚房用品 也可以增加配件 隨手洗起來的杯子可以倒扣晾乾 第一層我放常用的杯子 第二層比較高 放置水壺保溫瓶 最下面是有客人來時備用的餐具 它可以隨時移動到你想去的地方 可以推到洗碗機旁 把剛洗好的杯子放回去 分享給熱愛生活的你們.
